heading: Rolling update
cmds: kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app-rolling --timeout=180s; kubectl -n s10 get pods -l app=app-rollin
kubectl -n s10 exec tester -- curl -s http://app-rolling-service | grep -io "version: v[0-9]"

heading: Rolling update
cmds: kubectl get pods -l app=app-rolling -w   (captured during the update)

heading: Rolling update
cmds: kubectl -n s10 get pods -l app=app-rolling --show-labels; kubectl -n s10 get rs -l app=app-rolling
kubectl -n s10 exec tester -- curl -s http://app-rolling-service | grep -io "version: v[0-9]"
kubectl -n s10 rollout undo deployment/app-rolling; kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app-rolling --tim

heading: Blue-green
cmds: kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app-blue --timeout=180s; kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app
kubectl -n s10 get svc myapp-service -o jsonpath="{.spec.selector}"; echo; kubectl -n s10 get endpoints myapp-
echo "--- 6 requests while Service -> BLUE:"; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do kubectl -n s10 exec tester -- curl -s h

heading: Blue-green
cmds: kubectl -n s10 get svc myapp-service -o jsonpath="{.spec.selector}"; echo; kubectl -n s10 get endpoints myapp-
echo "--- instant rollback to BLUE:"; kubectl -n s10 apply -f 02-blue-green/service-blue.yaml; sleep 4; kubect

heading: Canary
cmds: kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app-stable --timeout=180s; kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/a
echo "--- 50 requests through the Service:"; for i in $(seq 1 50); do kubectl -n s10 exec tester -- curl -s ht

heading: Canary
cmds: kubectl -n s10 scale deployment app-canary --replicas=3; kubectl -n s10 scale deployment app-stable --replicas
echo "--- 50 requests after increasing canary to 3/10:"; for i in $(seq 1 50); do kubectl -n s10 exec tester -

heading: Recreate
cmds: kubectl -n s10 apply -f 04-recreate/deployment-v1.yaml -f 04-recreate/service.yaml; kubectl -n s10 rollout sta
kubectl -n s10 get deployment app-recreate -o jsonpath="{.spec.strategy}"; echo; kubectl -n s10 exec tester --
kubectl -n s10 apply -f 04-recreate/deployment-v2.yaml; kubectl -n s10 rollout status deployment/app-recreate

heading: Recreate
cmds: kubectl get pods -l app=app-recreate -w   (captured during the update)

heading: Recreate
cmds: kubectl -n s10 get pods -l app=app-recreate --show-labels | sed "s/pod-template-hash=[a-z0-9]*,//"; kubectl -n

heading: Pod lifecycle – 12 Termination
cmds: kubectl delete pod lifecycle-termination --wait=false; kubectl get pod lifecycle-termination -w

heading: Pod lifecycle – CrashLoopBackOff and liveness restart (polled)
cmds: kubectl get pod lifecycle-liveness   (after liveness probe failure)
